Match race: A and B swipe right at the same
moment, and each check misses the other.
Both swipe at once: why can a match be missed?
Two writes followed by two reads: each read runs before the other's
write lands. That is write skew (Ch 7).
A Bloom filter per user. A false positive skips an unseen profile, which
